catalysts.headline: Exclusive option to license Hebei Senlang Biotechnology's CD7-targeting asset (carried from prior research pass)

Announced an exclusive option to license Hebei Senlang Biotechnology's CD7-targeted lentiviral in-vivo CAR-T platform (led by a Phase 1 BCMA/GPRC5D dual-targeting candidate for multiple myeloma), paired with a ~$2.5M warrant-based private placement

Tempest and Hebei Senlang Biotechnology announce a development collaboration; first step is an investigator-initiated trial (IIT) in China of Tempest's CD7-targeted in vivo CAR-T candidate TPST-4003 in approx. 10 patients with myasthenia gravis or multiple sclerosis, with first dosing expected Q4 2026 and initial clinical data guided for H1 2027

Tempest Q2 2026 results disclose a Q2 2026 warrant inducement raising approx. $1.7M (one secondary source states $2M), on top of a March 2026 private placement of common stock and warrants that raised net proceeds of $1.7M
